scope: Independent arithmetic and textual custody audit of four already-written classical TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT results and 80 CV fit records; scientific run remains outside this audit.

method.execution: inline Python standard library only; no project module import or call
method.metric_arithmetic: integer contingency counts and exact Fraction ratios, rational group means, then float conversion; per-group majority predicts zero on equality
method.cv_mean_arithmetic: math.fsum of four recorded float fold scores divided by four, exact float comparison
method.cv_selection: maximum exact mean; first candidate in frozen order on exact equality; no tolerance used for selection
method.sample_binding: exact sequence equality with frozen manifest GOLD/BACKGROUND filter; no SILVER or TEST predictions included
method.weight_review: rational 1/n per actual training group; totals matched stored fit metadata, not an observation of estimator internals

LOGISTIC_REGRESSION.reason: CV JSON stores scalar fold GMBA and fit metadata, not fold validation predictions.

SVM_RBF.reason: CV JSON stores scalar fold GMBA and fit metadata, not fold validation predictions.

RF_TUNED.reason: CV JSON stores scalar fold GMBA and fit metadata, not fold validation predictions.

limitations: CV fold validation predictions are absent from the audited records; fold scalar metrics are not independently recomputed. Candidate means, exact selection and all recorded training/validation memberships are checked.

Stored fit metadata, including per-class weight totals and estimator/scaler parameters, is checked against the design. This audit cannot independently observe the actual per-row vector supplied to the library or learned model state.
TRAIN metrics are resubstitution. Neither observation rows nor sites/tracks are independent experimental acquisitions; these arithmetic checks do not establish scientific generalization.
No final family or SILVER regime selection is performed by this audit. CNN, subsequent fits, final TEST access/evaluation and terminal counters are outside this interim scope.
This record reports bounded agent actions and textual records, not system-wide syscall monitoring.
